source_node.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Log Path Traversal (api/settings/log)
source_node.precondition: Remote network access and low-privilege authenticated user credentials for the piSignage player web application (version < 2.6.4) on a Raspberry Pi device.
source_node.postcondition: Download of arbitrary local files across the Raspberry Pi file system via the 'api/settings/log?file=../' parameter traversal, exposing sensitive configurations, source code, and stored system credentials.

target_node.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default Credentials Administrator Access
target_node.precondition: Network reachability (e.g., SSH, local login, or service console) to Raspberry Pi OS (version <= 5.10) where the factory default credentials for account 'pi' with password 'raspberry' remain unchanged.
target_node.postcondition: Attacker acquires administrator (sudo/root) privileges and unrestricted control over the Raspberry Pi operating system and resident applications.

offline.claim: Path traversal file download enables exfiltration of Linux credential stores (/etc/shadow, password hashes) or application config files, verifying or extracting default 'pi:raspberry' credentials to obtain administrator privileges.

source_node.label: Oculus Browser Arbitrary HTML UI Injection and Potential Code Execution
source_node.precondition: Target user browsing the web using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11) visits an attacker-controlled remote web page.
source_node.postcondition: Arbitrary HTML injected into the Oculus Browser user interface, facilitating UI spoofing, credential phishing, and potential code execution in the context of an unprivileged local user session.

target_node.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Privileged File Write Local Privilege Escalation
target_node.precondition: Unprivileged local process execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop (version < 1.44.0.32849) capable of creating file-system hard links to log files targeted by OVRRedir.exe.
target_node.postcondition: Arbitrary file write with the elevated permissions of the privileged OVRRedir.exe process, resulting in full local privilege escalation to Administrator or SYSTEM on Windows.

offline.claim: Potential code execution achieved via Oculus Browser UI injection provides the initial local unprivileged Windows execution context required to craft log hard links and trigger OVRRedir.exe arbitrary file write.
